# Check if secteur 6 won against enugu rangers
# First, find the row where secteur 6 is team 1 and enugu rangers is team 2
row = df[(df['team 1'] == 'secteur 6') & (df['team 2'] == 'enugu rangers')]

# If no such row, check the reverse where secteur 6 is team 2 and enugu rangers is team 1
if row.empty:
    row = df[(df['team 1'] == 'enugu rangers') & (df['team 2'] == 'secteur 6')]

# Extract the aggregate score
agg_score = row['agg'].iloc[0]

# Parse the aggregate score to determine winner
# The format is "X - Y" or "X - Y (Z - W pen)"
# First split by space to get the main score
main_score = agg_score.split()[0] + ' ' + agg_score.split()[2]

# Split the main score by dash to get goals for each team
if row['team 1'].iloc[0] == 'secteur 6':
    # secteur 6 is team 1, so first number is their goals
    secteur_6_goals = int(main_score.split('-')[0].strip())
    enugu_goals = int(main_score.split('-')[1].strip())
else:
    # secteur 6 is team 2, so second number is their goals
    enugu_goals = int(main_score.split('-')[0].strip())
    secteur_6_goals = int(main_score.split('-')[1].strip())

# Determine if secteur 6 won (more goals than enugu rangers)
answer = secteur_6_goals > enugu_goals
